items.en: Thank you so much for your help yesterday. I couldn't have finished it without you.
items.ko: 어제 도와줘서 정말 고마워요. 당신이 아니었으면 끝내지 못했을 거예요.

items.en: I'm sorry I was late this morning. My train stopped for twenty minutes.
items.ko: 오늘 아침에 늦어서 죄송해요. 기차가 20분 동안 멈춰 있었어요.

items.en: Thanks for the lovely gift. I'll use it every day.
I'm sorry for not calling you back. I was really busy at work all week.
items.ko: 다시 전화 못 해서 미안해요. 일주일 내내 회사에서 정말 바빴어요.

items.en: I really appreciate your advice. It helped me make the right decision.
items.ko: 조언해 줘서 정말 감사해요. 덕분에 올바른 결정을 할 수 있었어요.
